data.name: Beyond.pl - DC2 / Poznan
data.notes:
Beyond.pl’s data centres in Poznan (Data Center 1 & Data Center 2) are all interconnected (10 km radius) with redundant dark fibre based on a private ring and redundant entry points on both ends. It is possible to connect with a standard cross connect. Both Poznan data centers are also connected using a private ring to our POP in LIM (Warsaw, Poland) and using our own private East-West Corridor to our POP in Interxion FRA15, Frankfurt Germany.

More information upon request. Contact us via e-mail: peeringdb@beyond.pl
